summary: Bind Research Library close and position events to the player's current frame.
details: Close and location callbacks require the player's actual current screen frame. A foreign, replaced or nested same-named element cannot close the retained library or overwrite its saved position; valid current-frame events retain their existing behavior.

Consumed real-source handler controls cover inert unrelated events, actual close and position changes, and preservation of another player's view and pending search. Separate negative controls detect name-only guards for each callback.

Controlled host execution preserves the accepted layout and native research-screen handoff. Native GUI input, save/load and two-client multiplayer qualification remain required; these controls do not close those obligations.
